title: contextual-shadow-slice-release-orchestrator
author: Ava Chen
description: Context and motivation: We need a safer way to run shadow traffic experiments that are both slice-aware and cost-efficient. Current shadowing duplicates full traffic and lacks per-slice observability, causing noisy comparisons and higher inference cost. This PR introduces a Contextual Shadow Slice Release Orchestrator that tiles shadow traffic across user/request slices, monitors per-slice metrics against SLOs using configurable statistical tests, and implements automated rollback/failover policies when drift or regressions are detected. Design summary: 1) Shadow tiling: tile factor and sampling policy per-slice; supports geographic, client_id, route, and content-type selectors. 2) Contextual comparators: per-slice metric buckets, bootstrapped ATE/KS tests, and drift scoring to identify statistically significant regressions. 3) Safety controller: per-slice SLO gates, global aggregation rules, and rollback actions (quarantine, traffic-hold, disable-shadow). 4) Integration hooks: trace-span propagation for shadowed requests, additional telemetry decorators, and optional payload hashing to preserve deterministic slices. 5) API: new /rollouts/shadow-slices endpoints for creating/updating slice policies; rollout config supports staged growth and annealing. Checklist: updates to orchestration controller; new e2e and unit tests; docs and migration notes; backward-compatible defaults; feature flagged rollout. Why this is unique: Instead of blanket shadow duplication, this system reduces cost by tiling while preserving statistical power per-slice; it provides clearer rollback signals tied to the actual affected cohorts. Backwards compatibility: default behavior when not configured remains previous whole-request shadowing. Migration notes: users with existing shadow configs must migrate to slice selectors to benefit from tiling; deprecated legacy_shadow.enabled config will redirect to the new flavors with a compatibility shim. Rollout plan: feature-flagged, staged rollout to internal beta customers for 2 weeks, then GA. Related work: builds on prior rollout controllers but introduces slice-aware metrics gating and tiled sampling (see ENG-8421).

review_thread: Diego Morales: Design LGTM but can we simplify the sampling API to avoid users specifying both tile_factor and sample_rate? Suggest default heuristics.
Ava Chen: Reply: Added heuristic mode; if sample_rate is omitted we compute it from tile_factor and target power. See tiling_scheduler.go comment.
Priya Kapoor: Requested change: add explicit guard when slice selector returns empty set to avoid accidental global shadowing. Please add unit test.
Ava Chen: Reply: Added guard and unit test tests/scheduler/empty_selector_test.go, CI passing locally.
